name: LazyTasks – Project & Task Management with Collaboration, Kanban and Gantt Chart
author: LazyCoders LLC

sections.installation:
How to Install LazyTasks

  • Download the Plugin: Navigate to the ‘Plugins’ section in your WordPress dashboard, click ‘Add New’, and search for LazyTasks in the WordPress Plugin Directory.

  • Install the Plugin: Once you find LazyTasks, click the ‘Install Now’ button next to the plugin name. WordPress will automatically download and install the plugin for you.

  • Activate LazyTasks: After installation is complete, you’ll need to activate LazyTasks to start using it. Find the plugin in your installed plugins list and click the ‘Activate’ link.

  • Automatic Onboarding: Once activated, go to the newly available LazyTasks section in your WordPress dashboard, you will be taken through our onboarding process to finish the installation process.

  • Happy Tasking!
sections.faq:
Q: What is LazyTasks?

  • LazyTasks is a project management and collaboration tool designed for WordPress, offering features like task management, kanban boards, Calendar, Gantt charts and more

Q: Is LazyTasks free to use?

  • YES! LazyTasks plugin is absolutely free and includes ALL features

Q: Is there any feature constraint on the free version of the plugin?

  • Absolutely not! It is totally free and the plugin comes with all features with no hidden fee or powerups or add-on. You can create unlimited projects, users, tasks and more.

Q: Can I access LazyTasks on mobile devices?

  • Yes, LazyTasks offers native apps for both iOS and Android, allowing for seamless mobile access.

Q: Does LazyTasks support team collaboration?

  • Absolutely. LazyTasks supports real-time collaboration with features like comments, mentions, and notifications.

Q: Are my data and projects secure with LazyTasks?

  • Yes, data security is a priority for LazyTasks, with robust encryption and privacy controls. You have complete control over your data.

Q: Can I integrate LazyTasks with other tools?

  • LazyTasks offers various integrations connecting with tools like calendars, communication apps, and more.

Q: Where can I seek help if I encounter issues with LazyTasks?

  • For support, visit the ‘Help’ section within the LazyTasks plugin or reach out through the support page on our website.

Q: Can I suggest new features or improvements?

  • Certainly! We highly value community feedback to enhance LazyTasks. Please contact us through our support page or directly via our website.

sections.description:
Your Comprehensive Task Management System

🟧 Description 🟧

⚠️ Notice: Note that we are still in Beta phase and constantly improving the plugin. If you find any issues or want to suggest a new feature, please feel free to reach out to us.

LazyTasks brings to WordPress an unparalleled task management experience that seamlessly integrates your project workflows into your WordPress environment. Crafted with efficiency in mind, LazyTasks is more than just a plugin; it’s a robust solution that creates the foundation for managing tasks, projects, and teams directly from your WordPress dashboard. Best of all, it comes with native mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms and maintains its commitment to excellence by being entirely free.

🟧 Why Choose LazyTasks? 🟧

📋 Comprehensive Task and Project Management
Create, assign, follow, and comment on tasks with ease. Our user-friendly interface ensures your projects are always on track and accessible.

🪧 Kanban Board
Visually manage your workflow with our intuitive Kanban board. Drag and drop tasks through different stages, from inception to completion.

🗒 Visualizing Projects
Our task list, kanban board, gantt chart, calendar, swimlane (upcoming) all these views provides you with muilti angel perspective to look at your projects, giving you enhanced visibility so nothing falls through the cracks

⚡️ Enhanced Productivity
Boost your team’s productivity by managing tasks and projects faster than ever before.

📱 Mobile Access
With native iOS and Android apps, manage your tasks on the go. Our mobile applications are designed to keep you connected and productive, no matter where you are.

🆓 Always Free
We believe powerful project management should be accessible to everyone. LazyTasks WP plugin are completely free, forever!

🟧 Features at a Glance 🟧

👥 Unlimited Users, Projects and Tasks for organized task management
📑 Kanban Boards for workflow visualization
🗂 Gantt Charts for project planning
🗓 Calendar Integration for deadline tracking
📱 Mobile Apps (iOS & Android) for on-the-go management
📤 Task Assignments and Follow-ups for team collaboration
💬 Comments on Tasks for seamless communication
⚙️ Notification template creation to use internally or even to integrate with other plugins
🔔 Web and Mobile Notification

🟧 Upcoming Features 🟧

🏁 August 2025
➡️ Social registration and login
➡️ Premium mobile app for iOS and Android

🏁 September 2025
➡️ Swim lanes for advanced task organization
➡️ ntegration with Gmail
➡️ Integration with Google Calendar
➡️ Integration with popular WP Discussion boards

🏁 October 2025
➡️ “Zen Mode” to plan and organize your tasks efficiently
➡️ Time Tracking on tasks

And much more!

🟧 Get Started with LazyTasks 🟧

Transform your WordPress site into a powerful project management hub with LazyTasks. Whether you’re managing a personal blog or running a multi-author site, LazyTasks can cater to all your task management needs, helping you stay organized and focused.

🟧 LazyTasks Mobile Apps 🟧

📱Free Mobile app

LazyTasks Free mobile app is now available for both iOS and Android with limited features.

📱Premium Mobile App

LazyTasks premium mobile app will be available from August 2025 for both iOS and Android with robust features and full support

📱 White label Mobile App for Your Organization

For building white lable mobile app for your organization , you have to buy a license of the plugin from our website at lazycoders.co

For the white lable app we require some basic & necessary information to build. Website URL / Domain name, App Name, Email, App LOGO, Splash Screen, License Key (must be valid) etc. We can create both Android & IOS app for you!

We provide you with the whitelabeled App on the fly as soon as you build it using our plugin!

  • Android App
    When you build an android app it will provide you 2 types of file extensions. They are: .apk & .aab. Those files are ready for publishing on your Play store.

  • iOS App
    We give you the facility to build your IOS App , which is ready for publication and can be automatically deployed to your app store.

🗿 Milestones

  • My Zen integration: 🧘
    Stay ahead of own schedule with our “My Zen” feature, ensuring you never miss a due date or any meetings. You can schedule the tasks assigned to you and plan better. “MyZen” also allows you to track time spent on each task so you can have visualization on how to improve.

  • Swim lane Views: 🏊
    Organize tasks in swimlane format for an additional layer of categorization, perfect for managing multiple projects or teams simultaneously.

  • Time Tracking ⏳️
    Elevate your project management by precisely tracking the time spent on each task, enabling more accurate planning and productivity analysis. This new feature is designed to provide deeper insights into work patterns and resource allocation, optimizing efficiency across your projects.

  • iOS and Android Mobile App 📱
    Mobile app for both iOS and Android to manage all your tasks, project and workspace on the go

😃 HAPPY TASKING! 🚀
